title: Thornwick
briefing: Thornwick clings to a bramble-choked ridge two days north. Its three wells have become power nodes, and the witch's minions prowl the hedgerows. Seize the wells and break her hold on the ridge.
victoryText: Thornwick's wells run clear again. The brambles wither and the ridge is yours.
defeatText: The thorns close over Thornwick. Its wells pulse with her ritual still.
